title: Keep manifest fixtures inside the tests tree
summary: Require fixture discovery and execution to agree on where primary tests and support files resolve.
benefits: Makes inventory portable across clean consumer checkouts
risks: Filesystem link behavior differs across host platforms

evidence.claim: Before the v0.0.4 release: Inventory enumerates file entries under the declared tests directory.
v0.0.4 requires declared test roots and fixture files to resolve within the intended tests directory.

decision.reason: Included in the owner-approved publication of Lydite v0.0.4. https://github.com/vixttha/Lydite-Test-Vault-Template/releases/tag/v0.0.4
